title: Redeem Codes
lead: Find codes to claim in Clash of Critters. Check their status and copy a code before redeeming it in game.

blocks.text: Active and unverified codes are listed separately from expired codes. Rewards and availability may vary by account or region.
Copy a code, open the code redemption screen in game, and paste it exactly as shown. If a code fails, check its expiry, account requirements and whether you already claimed it.
